title: Eyes of the Dark
html:
This article is about the passive feature. For the spell, see Eyes of the Dark: Darkness. For the condition, see Eyes of the Dark (Condition). For the same passive with a different name, see Superior Darkvision.

Eyes of the Dark is a passive feature that prevents  Disadvantage when attacking creatures in the dark within 24 m (80 ft), double the distance of normal  Darkvision.

Description

You can see in the dark up to 24 m (80 ft).

How to learn

Classes:

  • Class level 1: Shadow Magic

Notes

  • When a hiding creature makes a stealth check against a creature with (superior) darkvision, and is within the range of (superior) darkvision:
    • Being  Lightly Obscured counts as being under  Clear Area instead.
    • Being  Heavily Obscured counts as being  Lightly Obscured instead.
  • This condition does not allow the character to see in magical  Darkness.

Brief preview

Can see in the dark up to 24 m / 80 ft.
